articles.summary: AUSTIN, Texas and DURHAM, N.C., Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Shattuck Labs, Inc. (Shattuck or the Company) (NASDAQ: STTK), a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of potential first-in-class monoclonal and bispecific DR3 blocking antibodies for the treatment of patients with inflammatory and immune-mediated diseases, today announced two upcoming poster presentations at United European Gastroenterology (UEG) Week 2026, taking place October 17–20, 2026, in Barcelona, Spain. Presentation Details Format: Moderated poster presentation Title: Development and Characterization of SL-846: A Half-Life Extended, Dual-Receptor (DR3 x IL23RA) Targeting Bispecific Antibody Presenter: Mahmud Hussain, Ph.D., Director, RD of Shattuck Labs Date/Time: October 19, 2026; 1:00–2:00 p.m. CEST Format: ePoster presentation Title: Soluble TL1A/Anti-TL1A Immune Complexes Induce De Novo Production of TL1A and Induce Anti-Drug Antibodies That Cross-Bind
articles.title: Shattuck Labs Announces Two Poster Presentations at UEG Week 2026
